tone: pastoral, exhortational, polemical, Christ-centered, participatory, and triumphant
target_reader: religion-naive adults and older adolescents near grade 6
translation_identity: firmly dynamic-equivalence, NLT-like in readability but independent
test_purpose: Source-side Passage-Sense Resolution packet for Colossians 2:6-15; no English candidate drafting is authorized until Human Editor approval.

sealed_context.instruction: Use only the Greek, source-side sense brief, and approved/contextual Matrix information. Do not use comparison translations or prior FLT English wording.

governing_rules: Do not draft English before Human Editor approval of this Passage-Sense packet.
Treat all pre-draft Matrix stubs as questions to resolve, not English locks.
Preserve Christ as the controlling contrast: human tradition / stoicheia versus Christ in v8; fullness of deity in Christ in v9; believers' fullness/status in Him in v10.
Do not imply that philosophy as an intellectual discipline is universally condemned; Paul's target is the deceptive teaching described in this context.
Do not resolve stoicheia by worker improvisation. Human Editor resolution is required before drafting.
Preserve the rhetorical relationship between plērōma in v9 and peplērōmenoi in v10 if natural English can do so without obscurity.
Preserve the strong deity claim in v9 and the bodily force of sōmatikōs.

Resolve the circumcision metaphor and the genitive 'circumcision of Christ' before drafting; avoid English that naturally sounds like a reference to Jesus' infant circumcision unless that is deliberately chosen.
Preserve the buried-with / raised-with / made-alive-with participation chain of vv12-13.
Do not identify cheirographon with the Mosaic law as a whole unless the Human Editor accepts that specificity after source-side review.
Resolve the victory imagery in v15, including apekdyomai and thriambeuō, before drafting.
Preserve continuity of archē/exousia with the cosmic rulers/authorities language already established in Col.1:16.

matrix_alerts.required_resolution: receiving Christ Himself versus receiving transmitted teaching about Him versus a fused sense
ongoing being-built-up process and mixed metaphor with rooting
context-specific deceptive philosophy/teaching without universal condemnation of philosophy
fullness in Christ and believers' cognate status in Him; preserve rhetorical link if possible
full deity / what belongs to being God, without weakening the claim or requiring opaque jargon
non-handmade circumcision metaphor and genitive 'of Christ'
Roman triumph/procession victory image and antecedent of en autō
carry off as spoil / take captive
stripping/removal and stripping/disarming; assess deliberate word-family link
forgive with grace-gift coloring where possible

verses.greek: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον, ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε,
ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε, περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ.
Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν·
ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς θεότητος σωματικῶς,
καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας,
ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός, ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν·
καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν, συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ· χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα,
ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ·
ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ, θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ.

passage_argument: Verses 6-7 turn Paul's Christ-centered warning into an exhortation: because the believers received Christ Jesus as Lord, they must continue living in Him, rooted, built up, established in faith, and overflowing with thanksgiving.
Verse 8 states the threat: a deceptive teaching can carry them off as spoil because it follows human tradition and the stoicheia of the world rather than Christ.
Verses 9-10 give the controlling reason: the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Christ, believers have their fullness/status in Him, and He is head over every ruler and authority.
Verses 11-13 describe participation in Christ through non-handmade circumcision, burial and resurrection with Him, and being made alive with Him despite former death in transgressions.
Verses 13-14 connect new life with God's forgiveness and the removal of the hostile written record by nailing it to the cross.
Verse 15 climaxes the unit with Christ/God's public victory over rulers and authorities, using stripping/disarming and Roman-triumph imagery.

proposition_map.proposition: Having received Christ Jesus the Lord, the believers are to continue their lives in Him, securely rooted, continually built up, strengthened in the taught faith, and overflowing with thanksgiving.
They must guard against being taken captive by an empty deceptive teaching grounded in human tradition and the stoicheia of the world rather than Christ.
All the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Christ; believers are filled/made complete in Him, who rules over every ruler and authority.
In Christ the believers underwent a non-human circumcision involving the stripping off of the fleshly body, and in baptism they were buried and raised with Him through faith in God's power.
Though dead in transgressions and uncircumcision, God made them alive with Christ, forgave transgressions, erased the hostile written record, removed it, and nailed it to the cross.
The rulers and authorities were stripped/disarmed, publicly exposed, and led in triumph/victory.

expressions.source_expression: παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον
expressions.primary_question: Does Paul foreground receiving Christ Himself, receiving the transmitted apostolic teaching about Him, or intentionally fuse both?
viable_alternatives: receive the apostolic message/tradition concerning Christ
a fused reception of Christ through the apostolic proclamation
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Do not settle before Human Editor review.

expressions.source_expression: διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης
expressions.primary_sense: the specific deceptive teaching threatening the Colossians, not an all-purpose condemnation of philosophy
expressions.reading_text_guidance: English must not naturally teach that every form of philosophy is evil.

viable_alternatives: cosmic/elemental spiritual powers associated with the world
expressions.discourse_evidence: Contrast with Christ; recurrence at 2:20; nearby rulers/authorities language may bear on the decision but does not by itself settle it.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: No worker improvisation; resolve before A/B/C.

expressions.primary_sense: the fullness of deity dwells bodily in Christ; believers have a cognate fullness/completion status in Him
expressions.discourse_evidence: The cognate wording creates a rhetorical handoff from who Christ is to what believers possess/become in Him; Col.1:19 already established fullness language.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Determine how much of the lexical link can remain audible in clear English.

expressions.primary_sense: the fullness of deity—what belongs to being God—dwells in Christ bodily
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Do not weaken to a vague divine quality; avoid unnecessary jargon if plain English can carry the claim.

expressions.primary_question: How should 'circumcision of Christ' be related to Christ without sounding like a reference to Jesus' own physical circumcision?
viable_alternatives: circumcision belonging to the Christ-defined covenant/community
retain a closer expression and explain in a note
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Resolve genitive and metaphor before drafting.

expressions.primary_sense: believers participate with Christ: buried with Him, raised with Him, made alive with Him
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Preserve the repeated participation logic even if sentence architecture changes for oral English.

expressions.source_expression: τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν
expressions.choice_risks: Do not equate the phrase with the Mosaic law as a whole without explicit source-side ruling.
expressions.reading_text_guidance: Resolve noun image and relation of dogmata before drafting.

expressions.source_expression: ἀπεκδυσάμενος ... ἐδειγμάτισεν ... θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ
expressions.primary_sense: rulers and authorities are stripped/disarmed, publicly exposed, and subjected to triumphal victory
viable_alternatives: lead them as captives in a triumphal procession
retain victory in reading text and explain Roman procession imagery in a note
expressions.primary_question: Does ἐν αὐτῷ point to Christ/Him or to the cross/it in the preferred source analysis?

human_editor_questions: 2:6 — How much transmitted-teaching sense should be heard in 'received Christ Jesus the Lord'?
2:8 — Which viable sense of stoicheia best explains this paragraph and its recurrence at 2:20?
2:9-10 — How strongly should English preserve the plērōma / peplērōmenoi wordplay?
2:11 — How should the non-handmade 'circumcision of Christ' be explained without implying Jesus' own circumcision?
2:14 — What exactly is the cheirographon with dogmata: debt record, written charge, or another formulation?
2:15 — How much Roman triumph imagery belongs in reading text, and what is the antecedent of en autō?
